small_constant.check_compiles_to: Optimized away in the timed path, same as the earlier inspections. The timed entry demand wf_bench_micro (demand/small_constant.disassembly:857-925) has no repetition loop and no call except heap take, memset and heap give: the whole 200-million-repeat mark loop is folded to the final-salt arithmetic and three stores at demand/small_constant.disassembly:876-883, and its only backedge is the 4096-cell SIMD checksum loop at demand/small_constant.disassembly:891-910. seq wf_bench_micro (seq/small_constant.disassembly:842-910) is the same instruction sequence with different addresses. The ledger records the literal loop as split and then 'PAR demand mark v5 pruned' (demand/small_constant.ll.ledger:7), so no request or hand-out site exists by design. wf_mark (demand/small_constant.disassembly:649-657) is three stores; the separately retained wf_workload (demand/small_constant.disassembly:667-782, three backedges) is not called by the timed entry.
small_constant.evidence: demand and previous and unversioned and twin share one executable (same SHA-256 469f1c79...) and the same IR as seq (b2fda875...); the timed demand path is therefore the seq computation with no pool query, no mark call and no repeated hot store. Surviving work is residual (allocation, zeroing, checksum), so the timing does not measure 200000000 mark repetitions and no qualified pass can rest on this cell.

recursion.check_compiles_to: Balanced recursion keeps both hand-out sides. The ledger lists a checked group for fib and a budget-carrying clone family for 1 of 1 cyclic components (demand/recursion.ll.ledger:9-10). wf__par_budget_fib (demand/recursion.disassembly:739-816) tests the budget at lines 740-741 and tail-jumps to wf__par_seq_fib when it is spent; above the cut it decrements the budget, calls wf__par_acquire_lane at line 759, publishes the first child at line 768, recurses on the other at line 771, joins at line 774 and releases at line 777, and with a null lane falls back to two budgeted recursive calls at lines 785 and 789. No request word is loaded in this function or its callers in this build: the only gate besides the budget is whether acquire_lane returns a lane. The sequential clone wf__par_seq_fib (demand/recursion.disassembly:818-843) keeps recursive computation with an accumulation loop at lines 827-833.
recursion.evidence: Sequential identity and query count: demand wf_bench_micro (demand/recursion.disassembly:866-905) calls wf__par_pool_active exactly once (line 873); zero branches at line 875 to the inactive path (lines 890-896) that calls wf__par_seq_fib once and multiplies by the repetition count, instruction-for-instruction the seq body (seq/recursion.disassembly:618-637, seq wf_fib at seq/recursion.disassembly:563-588; wf__par_seq_fib matches wf_fib after address and label normalization). spine.check_compiles_to: The spine hand-out point now compiles to sequential code. The ledger records the call grain actualization: join site leaf runs after the join, kept static work 4 below 150000, no recursion (demand/spine.ll.ledger:9), and no budget family or sequential clone is emitted ('family emitted for 0 of 1 cyclic components', demand/spine.ll.ledger:10). The demand IR is byte-identical to seq (4478a0f0...), previous keeps the budgeted family (bed1acc6..., previous/spine.ll.ledger:9-11). In the demand image the workload region holds only wf_leaf, wf_spine, wf_workload and wf_bench_micro (demand/spine.disassembly:578-857); there is no wf__par_budget_spine and no wf__par_seq_spine, and none of the four functions calls into the pool. Leaf arithmetic survives as loops, not a constant: rotate-by-7 and multiply-by-3 lea chains in the unrolled spine loop (demand/spine.disassembly:617-637, rol at lines 621-632), its remainder loop (demand/spine.disassembly:644-651) and in the timed entry's inlined copies (demand/spine.disassembly:806-828 and 837-844, rol at lines 808-823 and 839). All four function bodies (wf_leaf, wf_spine, wf_workload, wf_bench_micro) have instruction text identical to seq (seq/spine.disassembly:563-842) after stripping addresses.
spine.evidence: Zero-query identity: demand wf_bench_micro (demand/spine.disassembly:763-857) contains no call at all, so the timed entry makes zero pool queries at every width. previous wf_bench_micro (previous/spine.disassembly:1075-1199) still calls wf__par_pool_active (line 1084) and loops over wf__par_recursion_budget (line 1094) and wf__par_budget_spine (line 1098), whose body (previous/spine.disassembly:759-891) retains the budget test, lane acquisition, publish and join.
